claim_results.rationale: The claim accurately reflects the requirement that evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for counterfeiting or alteration pursuant to 8 FAM 201.1. The passive construction carries no explicit actor.

claim_results.rationale: The claim fully captures the prohibition on continuing to use a previous name after a material name change, as well as the explicit exception when permitted by name change documentation.

source_spans.quote: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name (see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names).

claim_results.rationale: The claim captures the provision that evidence of identity might be required under 22 CFR 51.23(c) in accordance with Department guidance to establish the best identifying name.

claim_results.rationale: The claim accurately reflects the mandatory suspension of a DS-11 application to request acceptable ID in the new name when a material name change occurred more than one year prior and ID is unupdated.

source_spans.quote: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.

claim_results.rationale: The claim correctly retains the governing scope from paragraph d(1) regarding name changes over one year prior and accurately reflects the permissive issuance of a limited-validity passport for urgent or emergency travel.

source_spans.quote: If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name;

claim_results.rationale: The claim fully captures the requirement for passport personnel to annotate the name change documentation as 'seen and returned' before sending it back with an IRL.

source_spans.quote: You must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL);

claim_results.rationale: The claim accurately conveys the exemption from submitting ID in the new name for DS-11 applicants whose material name change occurred within one year of applying.

source_spans.quote: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name.

source_spans.quote: However, if the ID has not yet been changed, they must submit their name change documentation.
